summary: Create a romantic, interactive single-page Hug Day website with a landing view and a button-triggered surprise reveal (custom background image + uploaded audio, hugging bears visual, and a glass-morphism message card) using a soft pastel romantic theme and mobile-friendly design.
architectural_notes: Single-page interactive site with two phases (landing + reveal) transitioned via button click.
Use user-provided assets: custom background image for Phase 2 and uploaded romantic audio to autoplay on reveal (subject to browser autoplay rules).
Use glass-morphism (semi-transparent white) card styling and lightweight animations (e.g., pop-in) for a 'magical' feel.
Mobile-first responsive design; elegant cursive heading typography and soft romantic pastel palette.
Phase 2 assets (hugging bears + glass card) should use transparency-aware formats/styling (e.g., PNG/WebP with alpha; readable text contrast over variable backgrounds).
Background image in Phase 2 should be applied with proper sizing/cropping (e.g., CSS background-size: cover; background-position: center) to 'show properly' across devices.
known_issues: Reported: Uploaded romantic song not playing on reveal.
Reported: Uploaded background image not visible in Phase 2 reveal.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page, mobile-friendly Hug Day experience with two phases (Phase 1 landing, Phase 2 reveal) controlled entirely on the frontend without requiring login or backend data.

Implement Phase 1 (Landing View) with: (1) main heading text exactly: "Happy Hug Day My Love"; (2) a cute, high-quality single teddy bear illustration as the hero image; (3) a prominent rounded center button labeled exactly: "Hug me! Pop me! 🧸".
On button click, transition smoothly and "magically" from Phase 1 to Phase 2 (Reveal) using simple animations, including a pop-in effect for the message card.
Implement Phase 2 (Reveal) background change to use the user-uploaded image file photo4.jpg as the background.
In Phase 2, start playing the user-uploaded romantic song automatically after the button click, with a clear fallback UI if autoplay is blocked by the browser (e.g., show a play control).
In Phase 2, display a cute animation or image depicting a male and female teddy bear hugging.
In Phase 2, render a glassmorphism-style card (semi-transparent white with blur) containing the provided message text exactly as given (do not alter characters, punctuation, quotes, or emojis).

Apply a consistent romantic visual theme across both phases: soft pastel pink/white/red palette, elegant cursive typography for headings, and a cohesive layout style that feels like a romantic greeting card (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).

Add required static assets to the frontend build: include generated illustrations in frontend/public/assets/generated and reference the uploaded background image photo4.jpg as a static asset (no backend image serving).
Fix Phase 2 (Reveal) background image rendering so the user-uploaded background is clearly visible after the button click, using the existing asset path for the uploaded image (photo4.jpg).

Fix Phase 2 (Reveal) audio playback so the user-uploaded romantic song reliably loads and starts playing immediately after the button click, and provide a clear manual play fallback if autoplay is blocked.

Update Phase 2 visuals to use a transparent (alpha) hugging-bears asset and ensure both the hugging-bears visual and the glassmorphism message card remain semi-transparent yet clearly readable over the background (i.e., transparent but still easy to see).

Update the Phase 1 hero teddy illustration to depict a single teddy bear holding a heart in its hands with the words "i love you" written on the heart, and ensure it displays crisply and centered as the hero image.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build Phase 1 landing view with heading 'Happy Hug Day My Love', single teddy bear hero illustration, and prominent rounded center button labeled 'Hug me! Pop me! 🧸'.
Implement Phase 2 reveal on button click with smooth magical transition, switching background to user-uploaded image and starting user-uploaded romantic audio.
Show hugging male/female bear animation or image in Phase 2 and display a glass-morphism semi-transparent message card with the exact provided text, using simple pop-in animation.
Apply soft romantic color palette (pastel pinks/whites/reds), elegant cursive typography for headings, and ensure mobile-friendly responsive layout.
Update Phase 1 hero illustration to be a single teddy bear holding a heart with 'i love you' written on it, matching the romantic theme.
Ensure Phase 2 hugging-bears visual is a transparent (PNG/WebP) image/animation and the glassmorphism message card remains transparent yet clearly readable over the background.
